comment: Blocked independent B37 Earth-level stone-dig/makemon attempt. C levelport reaches Earth and applying the wished pick-axe west starts the dig occupation. Its next turn runs the Wizard of Yendor teleport (teleport.c:tele -> collect_coords at step 62) and prints a pager; the remaining `.` inputs are consumed while that pager remains active, so this bounded recipe never reaches dig.c:dig or the Earth-level makemon call. The cache-only attempts b37-earth-dig-trial-v2 through v6 preserve setup history; this input has no C recording and is not completion evidence.
